create.title: Exact far-cone and microscopic nearest-square reduction
create.statement_tex: Let R=X^(1/4), y=floor(sqrt X), N=floor X=y^2+q with 0<=q<=2y, and fix 0<rho<1/8. Let A_rho(m) be the exact Round-140 incomplete coefficient with least-odd threshold r_h, and let C(m)=sum_(hr=m, r odd, r>4h)chi_4(r). On the disjoint dyadic blocks I_M=[M,2M) intersected with the profile support, put k_m=floor(sqrt(Nm)+1/2) and j_m=k_m^2-Nm. Then the exact frozen scalar equals sum_M sum_(m in I_M, |j_m|>sqrt M) m^(-3/4)V_low(R^2m/N)C(m)e(sqrt(Nm))+O_epsilon(X^epsilon). The exact floor-to-cone correction has weighted mass O(log X). The phase cell indexed by k has real m-length 2k/N<<R^(-1), and the quadratic-congruence bound rho_N(j)<<_epsilon N^epsilon|j|^(1/2) makes all nonzero cells 0<|j_m|<=sqrt M target-safe. Exact radicals are m=Dt^2 when N=Du^2 and are target-safe. The remaining nonresonant cone scalar is not estimated.
create.next_action: Prove the fixed-centre nonresonant cone estimate sum_M sum_(m in I_M, |k_m^2-Nm|>sqrt M)m^(-3/4)V_low(R^2m/N)C(m)e(sqrt(Nm))<<_epsilon X^epsilon. The accepted congruence count, divisor pairing, generic additive cancellation, source imports, and another canonical transform do not supply it.

create.title: Singleton cells, exact divisor pairing, quarter mode, and source obstruction
create.statement_tex: For the far scalar, nearest-integer phase cells have length O(R^(-1)) and contain at most one integer, while the elementary congruence count prices a window |j|<=J by M^(-3/4)J^(3/2)X^epsilon and reaches target scale only at J=sqrt M. Writing m=2^nu n with n odd gives the exact identity sigma_chi4(n)=(1+chi_4(n))A_nu(n)+B_nu(n): on chi_4(n)=-1 it is blind, and on chi_4(n)=1 it returns the complete r_2(2^nu n)/4 coefficient plus an exact owner-sized central band. The literal incomplete coefficient satisfies sum_(m<=M)A_rho(m)e(m/4)=i*pi*M/8+O(M^(3/4)) and its m^(-3/4)-weighted version is i*pi*M^(1/4)/2+O(log M), so uniform additive cancellation and low variation are false. After target-safe ratio smoothing the exact double-Mellin arithmetic factor is 4^(-t)zeta(s+t)L(s-t,chi_4), but the audited Robert--Sargos, Sargos--Wu, Tao--Trudgian--Yang, complete radial, standard-twist, subconvex, and moment routes all retain a positive R-power, have the wrong coefficient or scalar direction, or violate a stated hypothesis. These are scoped no-go controls, not a signed lower bound or target failure.
create.next_action: Park singleton-cell cancellation, wider near-radical extrapolation from the elementary root count, full-divisor completion, uniform additive partial sums, low coefficient variation, sharp Perron truncation, direct imports of the audited theorems, and another invertible transform. Reopen only with an actual fixed-centre signed correlation mechanism for the nonresonant cone.

Its raw weighted incidence capacity is R^(1/2+o(1)); actual signed cancellation is unproved.
The complete and central sums vanish there, but supported prime fibres have a nonzero far coefficient.
Fibre grouping, character signs, and nonlinear phases can cancel; only raw incidence capacity was proved.
